ASIA PACIFIC UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY & INNOVATION
CT046-3-2 Systems Analysis and Design - Group Assignment
Intake: APD2F2609

Deliverable 1: Project Proposal
Weightage: 15%
Due: Week 5
Describe the chosen organisation, the problems it faces and the objectives of the new system.

Deliverable 2: Requirements Specification
Weightage: 25%
Due: Week 8
Collect requirements through interviews and questionnaires, and document them with use case diagrams.

Deliverable 3: System Design Document
Weightage: 30%
Due: Week 11
Produce the ERD, data flow diagrams and interface mock-ups.

Deliverable 4: Presentation
Weightage: 20%
Due: Week 13

Deliverable 5: Peer Assessment
Weightage: 10%
Individual marks may be adjusted by up to 20% based on the peer assessment.

Total weightage: 100%
